comment: The section provides a strong rationale for semantic governance, but SGI is described both as an “infrastructure” and as a non-technical governance capability. The word infrastructure may lead readers to expect a new platform or product.

anchor.note: p.57-58 l.Lines 373-398 read as the printed page; section 3.4.5 agrees

public.text: The section provides a strong rationale for semantic governance, but SGI is described both as an “infrastructure” and as a non-technical governance capability. The word infrastructure may lead readers to expect a new platform or product.
public.suggestedRevision: Consider renaming it Semantic Governance Framework and Capabilities, or state prominently and consistently that SGI is an institutional and operational capability supported by tools, not a separate software component.
